messages:
meera: Quick check — aiming to cut the release at Fri 10:00 PT. Can CS/Support and Marketing confirm comms and docs are ready? I'll own the deploy and smoke checks. :rocket:

jordan: I'm free to jump in for DB migrations if we need a hand. Which endpoints are changing? Any schema work? :thinking:

lina: Docs PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — release notes in the PR description. Marketing draft for email is in #marketing-drafts, ready for a last pass. :white_check_mark:

sam: Rollback plan? Who's primary on rollbacks and what's the quick command to revert? Want to make sure support has it handy. :warning:

meera: Rollback owner = sam (primary), jordan (backup). Quick revert is a single canary switch in route manager + rollback tag. Commands for on-call:

```
# promote previous stable
redwood route promote --name inference-api --tag stable-2024-09-15
# or rollback the canary
redwood release rollback --service inference-api --to-tag stable-2024-09-15
```

I'll paste a short checklist for Support below.

devops-bot: Deploy window confirmed for 2024-09-20 17:00 UTC (Fri 10:00 PT). Autoscaling will be disabled for the 15m rollout window as requested. :gear:

meera: Smoke owners: API surface - jordan; Console/UX - lina; Observability/traces - meera. Smoke checklist (quick):
- sanity curl to /health
- run 5 sample prompts through the canary
- verify token and cost metrics show expected ranges
- confirm no regressions on top 10 prompt set

Please add any blockers now. If no blockers by EOD Thu we'll proceed. Support: paste rollback commands in the runbook and pin the release notes link. :memo:

lina: I'll update the support-runbook and add the marketing blurb to the email draft. Also adding a short FAQ for any model-behavior differences. :+1:

jordan: Noted. I'll be on-call during the window and will watch migrations and latency. Tag me if you want me to cut the DB steps. :computer:

sam: Copy. I added rollback commands to the support runbook and included contact list (meera/jordan). I'll stand by during the window. :phone:

meera: Thanks all. Final ask: CS lead, can you confirm the "customer-impact" section in the notes — minimal for this release? If yes I'll post the public release notes after the window. :sunglasses:

lina: CS lead (cc: @emily-cs) confirmed via DM — impact: none, opt-in customers only. :white_check_mark:

meera: Great. No blockers. Will post final readiness message 30m before cut. :rocket:
